DPE-2026-0001.dpia: Verify that no measurement request leaves before consent is recorded, rather than accepting a statement that tags are 'consent-gated'.
DPE-2026-0001.procurement: On delivery, a capture in the no-interaction state shows no requests to third-party measurement hosts and no identifier cookies.
DPE-2026-0001.complaint: A HAR of the no-interaction state, the timestamp of the consent event, and the falsifier list worked through.
DPE-2026-0001.audit_question: Show me a network capture of the homepage before anyone clicks the banner.

DPE-2026-0002.dpia: Verify that refusing changes the outgoing traffic, rather than accepting that a consent tool is installed.
DPE-2026-0002.procurement: On delivery, the set of third-party hosts contacted after refusal is empty of measurement hosts, demonstrated by two captures.
DPE-2026-0002.complaint: Two HARs, no-interaction and refused, plus the read-back consent state proving the refusal registered.
DPE-2026-0002.audit_question: Show me two captures, one where the visitor refused, and tell me the difference.

DPE-2026-0003.dpia: Verify that a refusal control exists and writes a negative state, rather than that a banner is present.
DPE-2026-0003.procurement: The consent dialogue offers refusal at the same level as acceptance, verifiable from the first screen.
DPE-2026-0003.complaint: A screenshot of every layer of the dialogue and the consent state written by each control.
DPE-2026-0003.audit_question: Where in the banner does someone say no, and what does that store?

DPE-2026-0004.dpia: Verify the actual lifetime of identifiers set before consent, rather than the retention table in the document.
DPE-2026-0004.procurement: No identifier is stored with a lifetime beyond what the stated purpose requires, and none before consent.
DPE-2026-0004.complaint: The Set-Cookie headers from the pre-consent capture, with lifetimes.
DPE-2026-0004.audit_question: What is the longest-lived cookie you set before anyone has chosen anything?

DPE-2026-0005.dpia: Verify whether in-page behaviour is captured and whether input fields are masked, rather than treating it as analytics.
DPE-2026-0005.procurement: No session recording is active before consent, and where used, input masking is enabled and demonstrated.
DPE-2026-0005.complaint: A capture showing the recording endpoint contacted at load, and whether field masking was active.
DPE-2026-0005.audit_question: Is anything recording mouse movement or keystrokes, and from what moment?

DPE-2026-0006.dpia: Verify that user-entered values do not travel to third parties, rather than that 'only page URLs' are shared.
DPE-2026-0006.procurement: No value entered or searched by a user appears in a request to a party outside the processing chain.
DPE-2026-0006.complaint: A capture using a distinctive search term, showing where that term reappears.
DPE-2026-0006.audit_question: Type a nonsense word into the search box and show me every request containing it.

DPE-2026-0007.dpia: Verify whether device characteristics are read by third parties, rather than checking only for cookies.
DPE-2026-0007.procurement: No third-party script enumerates device characteristics for recognition purposes before consent.
DPE-2026-0007.complaint: A trace of property reads with the initiating script per read.
DPE-2026-0007.audit_question: What reads the canvas, the fonts or the time zone, and who does it belong to?

DPE-2026-0008.dpia: Verify who actually hosts each form and what it sets, rather than treating a supplier form as an internal one.
DPE-2026-0008.procurement: Forms are served from the controller's own domain, or the third-party host sets nothing before submission.
DPE-2026-0008.complaint: A capture of the form page at load, showing the host and the cookies it sets.
DPE-2026-0008.audit_question: When someone fills in your contact form, whose domain are they on?

DPE-2026-0009.dpia: Verify which external resources the page loads on first byte, rather than reviewing only the tracking section.
DPE-2026-0009.procurement: All fonts, scripts and libraries are served from the controller's own infrastructure.
DPE-2026-0009.complaint: A capture of the initial document with every subresource host listed.
DPE-2026-0009.audit_question: Which hosts does the page contact before any script of yours has run?

DPE-2026-0010.dpia: Compare the measured recipients against the recipients named in the published privacy statement of the same date.
DPE-2026-0010.procurement: Every party receiving personal data is named in the published statement, verified against a capture on delivery.
DPE-2026-0010.complaint: A capture of recipients plus the archived statement of that date, and the set difference between them.
DPE-2026-0010.audit_question: Name every party that receives data, then let me check that against the traffic.

DPE-2026-0011.dpia: Verify what fires at runtime rather than reading the page source, and require the container version history.
DPE-2026-0011.procurement: The supplier delivers the tag container version history alongside the site, so what ran when is auditable.
DPE-2026-0011.complaint: A capture showing an identifier in traffic that is absent from the fetched HTML.
DPE-2026-0011.audit_question: Which tags does your container load that are not in the source, and who can change them?

DPE-2026-0012.dpia: Verify what the device contacts while idle, rather than accepting the telemetry section of the manual.
DPE-2026-0012.procurement: The device contacts no host that serves no function the owner enabled, demonstrated by an idle capture.
DPE-2026-0012.complaint: An idle capture at the gateway, with firmware version and region, and the destinations established by routing.
DPE-2026-0012.audit_question: Unplug everything it does and tell me what it still talks to.

DPE-2026-0013.dpia: Inventory the bundled components and what each contacts, rather than reviewing only the application's own code.
DPE-2026-0013.procurement: The supplier delivers a component inventory listing every bundled library and the hosts it contacts.
DPE-2026-0013.complaint: A static inventory plus a capture from a fresh install before the first screen is dismissed.
DPE-2026-0013.audit_question: List every third-party library you ship and what each one sends home.

DPE-2026-0014.dpia: Verify that the control that stops collection exists and survives a reboot and an update.
DPE-2026-0014.procurement: Any collection beyond what is strictly necessary can be switched off, and the setting survives updates.
DPE-2026-0014.complaint: Captures with the control on, off, and again after a reboot and an update.
DPE-2026-0014.audit_question: Turn it off, restart it, update it, and show me it is still off.
